Clock: day numbers in the player's words.name: Clock: day numbers in the player's words

effects.instruction: Narrator only: "Day N" in the player's words is the day count in the header: Day 1 is Sunday, March 31, Day 2 is Monday, April 1, Day 3 is Tuesday, April 2, and so on. It never means the Nth of a month; name the weekday and date that match, and keep them the same in every line of the turn.
